feeds.title: The Ace Black Movie Blog
feeds.description: The Ace Black Movie Blog was established in 2007 and features reviews of current and classic movies in all genres.

feeds.title: Blackfilm.com
feeds.description: With a library of more than 9,000+ articles, interviews with top talent, and film reviews, blackfilm.com provides the best in news, editorial, and entertainment content on film, television, and the theatre scenes.

feeds.title: Black Girl Nerds » Film
feeds.description: Explore the latest news about the most prominent Black women celebrities, writers, actors, directors,etc. in the film industry. Black Girl Nerds is an online publication and multimedia space that is the intersection of geek culture and Black feminism. I named this site Black Girl Nerds because the concept of Black women as geeky-dorky beings is somewhat of an anomaly. We represent a wide array of diverse women who embrace all cultures and refuse to conform to the status quo.

feeds.title: Pan African Film & Arts Festival (PAFF) Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest News from the Pan African Film & Arts Festival. Established in 1992, The Pan African Film Festival (PAFF) is a non-profit corporation dedicated to the promotion of cultural and racial tolerance and understanding through the exhibition of film, art and creative expression.

feeds.title: Artmattan Films Virtual Cinema Blog
feeds.description: Explore various black films, reviews, synopsis and more! ArtMattan Films, the film distribution arm of ArtMattan Productions, is a Theatrical, Educational, TV, DVD, and VOD distributor of over 120 films from Africa, the Caribbean, Latin America, Europe, Australasia, Asia and North America, spotlighting the human experience of people of color all over the world.

feeds.title: Kemi Filani News » Movies
feeds.description: Get the Gist on Nigerian Movies, Nollywood news and Movie Reviews. Kemi Filani News is a full fledged top all-round news site that serves millions of seeking readers daily.

feeds.title: The British Blacklist
feeds.description: Since 2012 The British Blacklist has been the go to platform for information about the exciting work of UK based Black storytellers from new talent to established household names to those who have become a part of Hollywood's elite. The British Blacklist LTD is a media platform that celebrates the work of UK-based Black creatives and those of the wider Diaspora who work across Screen, Stage, Literature, and Sound.

feeds.title: BellaNaija » Nollywood
feeds.description: Read breaking, latest and top stories in Nollywood. BellaNaija brings the latest news, scoop, gist, features, lifestyle, inspiring motivating stories, and music daily. BellaNaija was born on the 1st of July 2006 as a blog.

feeds.title: Denton Black Film Festival Blog
feeds.description: At the Denton Black Film Festival, we share stories of the Black community - our traditions, ideas and experiences - in a multitude of ways. Each festival, held annually in January, features Black cinema, music, art, spoken word, comedy, food and fashion. It's our way of bringing the Black experience to life.

feeds.title: Black America Web » TV & Film
feeds.description: Your one-stop for all things Black America TV & Film! Breaking news, entertainment news, celebrity news, Black-owned businesses, and Black history facts. Black America Web, launched in June 2001, is a broad-based effort to become a timely and credible source for news and information covering all aspects of daily life, featuring a wide array of viewpoints and perspectives.

feeds.title: The Curvy Critic
feeds.description: Carla Renata aka The Curvy Film Critic reviews films and interviews with talent above and below the line in the film industry. She is a Rotten Tomatoes Approved critic and member of the Critics Choice Association (CCA) and Co-President of their Documentary Branch, African American Film Critics Association (AAFCA), Online Association of Female Film Critics (OAFFC), and more.

feeds.title: Targeting: College Football Podcast
feeds.description: College football podcast presented by the guys at S&S. During the season we preview top games, provide expert betting insight, and discuss the fun happenings on and off the field. In the offseason we debate hot college football topics, discuss power ranking and gambling theories, and comprehensively preview the Power 5 conferences.

feeds.title: The New Black Film Collective Blog
Black Film Archive by Maya S. Cade
feeds.description: Black Film Archive is a living register of Black films. In its current iteration, it showcases every* Black made film from 1915 to 1979 currently streaming. This newsletter serves as its blog.

feeds.title: Black World Cinema Blog
feeds.description: Black World Cinema is a showcase of seldom seen classic features and new films from around the world. Its mission is to presents films by filmmakers that bring us stories with compelling content and a human dimension seldom presented in mainstream cinema.

feeds.title: People of the African Diaspora in Period & Costume Films
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to highlight the presence of the people of the African Diaspora in period costume dramas. It is also to provide a historical context to the films featured.

feeds.title: Toronto Black Film Festival
feeds.description: The Toronto Black Film Festival is dedicated to showing the diversity within the black communities! In connecting black films with viewers of all colors and ethnic origins we recognize the differences that make us unique and celebrate the shared values that bring us together.

feeds.title: Calgary Black Film Festival
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the Festival, film industry, black celebrity community and more! The Calgary Black Film Festival is dedicated to giving unique voices in cinema the opportunity to present audiences with new ways of looking at the world.

feeds.title: Nollywood Reinvented
feeds.description: Your one-stop for all your Nollywood movie reviews and news including Nigerian and Ghanaian movies and television shows. Nollywood REinvented is an online platform launched on January 22, 2011, that delivers clear and easy-to-follow reviews on a majority of the recently and afore released African movies. Nollywood REinvented's mission is to provide fairness to the movie maker and honesty to the movie lovers.

feeds.title: African Diaspora International Film Festival Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the Festival, film industry, black celebrity community and more! Established in 1993, the African Diaspora International Film Festival (ADIFF) is a Harlem based minority-led not-for-profit international film festival that presents, interprets and educates about films that explore the human experience of people of color all over the world in order to inspire imaginations, disrupt stereotypes and help transform attitudes that perpetuate injustice.

feeds.title: National Black Movie Association
feeds.description: The National Black Movie Association is a multi-faceted organization focusing on diversity and inclusion opportunities for African Americans within the film industry. The organization is purposed to advocate for the underserved community through Marketing, research, public awareness, and support.

feeds.title: Film Africa News
feeds.description: Explore the latest news and updates on the black film industry, the festival, celebrities and more! Established in 2011, Film Africa is London's biggest festival celebrating the best African cinema brought to you by the Royal African Society.

feeds.title: Cascade Festival of African Films Blog
feeds.description: Read occasional news and announcements on the CFAF blog. The Cascade Festival of African Films is the longest-running annual, non-profit, non-commercial, largely volunteer-run African Film Festival in the United States.

feeds.title: Black Media Review Collective
feeds.description: ... the go-to site for African-Americans to receive reviews of African-American television and film from other African-Americans. More importantly, BMRC is a vehicle for African-American adult consumers to both voice their honest opinion about portrayals of African-Americans in television and film and have access to the authentic thoughts and criticism of the portrayals of African-Americans from other African-American adult consumers.

feeds.title: Film Quarterly » Black Film
feeds.description: Film Quarterly offers serious film lovers in-depth articles, reviews, and interviews that examine all aspects of film history, film theory, and the impact of film, video, and television on culture and society.

feeds.title: Blacks in Period Films
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to highlight the presence of the people of the African Diaspora in period costume dramas. It is also to provide a historical context to the films featured.

feeds.title: Defender Network » Movies
feeds.description: Houston's Leading Black News & Information Source

feeds.title: SDM Magazine » Black Cinema
feeds.description: Fashion, Culture, Lifestyle, Music, Media

feeds.title: Black Cinema Connection
feeds.description: Reflections, Perceptions and Misconceptions of Black Culture in Film

feeds.title: East African Film Network Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on East African Film Network, upcoming movies and more! We are a Civil Society organisation that champions social, economic and human development and integration of East African Community region through mass media in general and movies in particular.

feeds.title: WalterFilm » African Americana
feeds.description: The goal of WalterFilm is to provide the finest selection of original movie star photos, movie scripts & rare books, lobby cards, vintage movie posters, and Hollywood movie memorabilia that focus on the glorious history of the European and Hollywood Motion Picture businesses. Read about African American films in the following section.

feeds.title: Continuum Film Blog
feeds.description: The blog by Ina - a visual and video installation artist. Ina's film writing includes reviews for Film Comment, Framework, The Journal of Cinema and Media, and Black Camera.

feeds.title: Discover African Cinema
feeds.description: We strive to educate the general public about African art and specifically African Cinema. My name is Soumaya and I created this website to share information about influential African films and artists mainly in the film world.

feeds.title: Shadow and Act » Film
feeds.description: We are a media brand providing breaking news, exclusive interviews, and analysis on the scope of Black entertainment today as well promoting creative content from the rising directors, writers, and producers of tomorrow. Shadow And Act is the premier digital destination dedicated to covering Black talent and entertainment across television, film and Broadway.

feeds.title: Black Indie Film
feeds.description: We provide the latest on the movie-going experience and the connection between Black Hollywood and their audience. We have and will continue to bring groundbreaking films to audiences that might not otherwise be available. Follow us to keep up with the latest movie trailers, interviews, reviews, hype, and everything about the cinematic experience straight from Black Hollywood and beyond. Black Indie Film is an online destination providing complete media coverage of film, television, and web content that is created by Black creatives and about Black people.

feeds.title: Indie Black Film Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to INDIE BLACK FILM LLC, where we empower independent filmmakers to bring their vision to life. Our mission is to level the playing field and help indie filmmakers compete with the major film studios. We offer a range of services designed to support filmmakers at every stage of their journey, from video editing to script coverage, film funding, and marketing.

feeds.title: RogerEbert.com » Black Writers Week
feeds.description: Welcome to the newly refreshed RogerEbert.com, the world's preeminent destination for movie criticism, commentary, and community. Read about films, reviews, critics, and more from black writers on their Black Writers Week.
